subject.title: fix(line): bound inbound media download body reads

question: Should LINE inbound media fail closed after a 120-second post-header body deadline, accepting an unavailable attachment rather than allowing an indefinitely dripping transfer?
rationale: The patch is mechanically focused, but the chosen wall-clock value changes delivery behavior for existing slow LINE uploads and is not a purely technical cleanup.

options.title: Adopt the separate 120-second body budget
options.body: Approve the fail-closed policy after current-head loopback proof confirms both a bounded drip and a slow valid transfer.

options.title: Choose a different LINE delivery policy
options.body: Set a different budget or retry/degradation behavior if preserving more slow transfers is more important than bounding the worker lifetime.

recommendation.title: Adopt the separate 120-second body budget
recommendation.body: Approve the fail-closed policy after current-head loopback proof confirms both a bounded drip and a slow valid transfer.
